name: Theremin
noAudio: Sound isn’t available in this browser
snapHint.free: Any pitch between notes — like a violin or a fretless neck. Playing in tune is up to your ear.
snapHint.magnet: The sound is pulled to the nearest note, but you can still glide smoothly between notes. Good for melodies and glissandos.
snapHint.note: Only notes of the scale sound; moving between them uses the chosen glide time.
about: Played with hands in front of the camera: one hand sets the pitch, the other the effects and volume.
hint.right: Right hand — pitch: higher hand, higher note; closer to the frame edge, brighter. Left hand — effects: higher, stronger; a fist is silence, an open palm is sound.
hint.left: Left hand — pitch: higher hand, higher note; closer to the frame edge, brighter. Right hand — effects: higher, stronger; a fist is silence, an open palm is sound.
privacy: The camera is processed only on this device: the image is neither stored nor sent anywhere.
err.denied: No access to the camera. Permission is granted in the device settings.
err.model: Hand tracking could not be loaded.
charHint: Pitch hand near the frame edge — brighter sound, near the middle — softer.
fxHint: Preset effects follow the height of the second hand: off at the bottom, full strength at the top. Fine tuning works as in the glider.
camHint: Without the image only note lines and hand points are shown.
